note: Ps136 the great Hallel (26v). Every deed answered by the refrain 'his steadfast love endures forever' (chesed = qualifier x26; 'endures forever' = temporal standalone x26). Human IB is thin: the fourfold GIVE-THANKS imperative (v1,2,3,26) framing the litany, and the people's LOW-ESTATE that God remembered (v23). God's deeds (does-wonders/made-heavens/struck-Egypt/divided-sea/led/gave-heritage/rescued/gives-food) = qualifiers; creation/Exodus imagery + 'endures forever' = standalone.

dims.v: paired with the antiphonal refrain of steadfast love
v1: 'GIVE THANKS (yadah) to the LORD, for he is good' - the opening imperative of the litany, thanks for God's enduring love.
paired with the antiphonal refrain of steadfast love
v2: 'GIVE THANKS (yadah) to the God of gods' - thanks to the supreme God.
paired with the antiphonal refrain of steadfast love
v3: 'GIVE THANKS (yadah) to the Lord of lords' - thanks to the sovereign Lord.
paired with the antiphonal refrain of steadfast love
v26: 'GIVE THANKS (yadah) to the God of heaven' - the closing imperative, sealing the litany of thanks.
v23: 'It is he who REMEMBERED us in our LOW ESTATE (shephel)' - the people's abasement, the humbled condition that God's love stooped to remember.

v1: 'endures FOREVER (olam)' - the perpetuity of God's love; temporal. Standalone.
